title: [bug] lichen-node rpl_stack test three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent fails on main (announce relay)
description: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/tests.rs:1792 — 'root did not accept the relayed leaf announce' panics. Reproduced on a CLEAN tree (git stash of unrelated changes) with: cargo test -p lichen-node --lib rpl_stack::tests::three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent. The test drains up to 6 frames looking for RplReceiveOutcome::AnnouncementAccepted from the leaf's iid and finds none. Appears to be an announce-relay delivery/timing issue in the rpl_stack test harness, pre-existing and unrelated to routing-table path changes. Found during worker6-4iax verification.
close_reason: Fixed. Root cause: the test three_rpl_stacks_send_leaf_dao_via_preferred_parent had a DUPLICATED drain loop — a first loop drained root's queue and DISCARDED the relayed leaf announce (consuming it), then a second loop searched again for the same announce and asserted on it, getting None (panic at tests.rs:1792 'root did not accept the relayed leaf announce'). Diagnosis via instrumented drain: the announce arrived at iteration 0 of the first loop. Fix: merged into a single bounded (6) drain loop that captures the outcome into root_outcome and breaks on the leaf's announce, then asserts; also removed a stray debug eprintln. The panic now moves PAST 1792 to a SEPARATE pre-existing DAO-phase frame-sequencing bug at tests.rs:1828 (root receives None instead of the relay's DAO) that was previously masked — filed as follow-up bead (discovered-from hr8t). 3x codereview delegated to reviewer model kimi-k3: correctness PASS, security PASS (peer.iid auth binding + Accepted/Rejected + replay StaleSeqNum coverage all preserved), edge-cases PASS (bounded-exhaustion fails loudly, line-topology harness is deterministic so bound 6 is >=2x headroom). 345 lib tests pass; the only failure is the latent 1828 bug. Committed as 5c0ecc11a4.
